instruction: Agnieszka Schäfer rang in sick (Fri 25 Sep to Thu 1 Oct). Could you get those shifts covered again? Kai Bauer emailed – we need extra staff on the shifts listed. Please get that on the rota. Have a look at the mail first, a few things came in this morning. The agency budget isn't signed off yet – ask me by mail before you book. Fill it as far as the rules allow. Please message everyone you move. Cheapest sensible option, please. Watch the rules – rest periods, nights in a row, the lot. At the end, send me the final status report (Reports → Status report) – every field has to match the finished rota. Don't reshuffle more than you have to. It's one of those weeks: there are swap requests in the requests list too. Please go through everything in the order the house rules give. Marek Meyer
